recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-3699; future Flag.subject target-set changes should be handled under the later subject-expansion issues.
issue_request: FHIR-3699 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Flag change request asking to rename Alert.subject to Alert.patient because the element only allowed Patient at the time.
initial_application: Git-svn commit b2d9ba199f61ad13cc2766c9feda757ccb378e3c (#3699, SVN revision 4797) applied the original request by changing old Alert examples, spreadsheet element names, and search paths from subject to patient.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-6171 deliberately superseded the patient-only premise by renaming Flag.patient back to mandatory Flag.subject, adding non-Patient targets, retaining patient search, and adding subject search. Later related decisions further broadened the same element: FHIR-10083 added PlanDefinition/Medication/Procedure, FHIR-20380 added PractitionerRole, and FHIR-37950 added RelatedPerson.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active Flag source uses Flag.subject with multiple non-Patient targets and keeps a patient search parameter that filters Flag.subject to Patient, so renaming the element to patient would be incorrect.

related_jiras.note: Later Published same-resource decision renamed Flag.patient back to mandatory Flag.subject and expanded targets; already audited separately on the combined branch.
Expanded Flag.subject to definitional/cautionary targets including PlanDefinition, Medication, and Procedure.
Added PractitionerRole to Flag.subject; already audited separately on the combined branch.
Added RelatedPerson to Flag.subject and its definition.
